verdict.rationale: Supabase offers RLS-based fine-grained authorization and says it encourages read-only access by default for its MCP integration (mitigating agent access scope), but a concrete hands-on community report shows the Cursor/Supabase MCP integration actually running with elevated service_role access that bypasses RLS entirely — the opposite of least-privilege scoping. This is a direct, concrete contradiction rather than general skepticism. Missing for 10: documented ability to mint scoped/least-privilege API keys or tokens specifically for agent use, and confirmation that MCP connections default to restricted roles rather than service_role.
